$comment: Generated by tools/Avalon.Exporter -- talent-catalog, from the seed. Do not edit by hand. Ids are surrogates that mean nothing; a character's saved talents name them. kind: 1 start, 2 small, 3 notable, 4 ability, 5 capstone, 6 keystone, 7 junction. name: set on a start, a notable, an ability, a capstone and a keystone, null on every other. angle: degrees in (-180, 180]; radius: layout units. forkGroupId: the capstone fork (forkGroups) of which a character holds one node at most, null on every other node. abilityId: the ability a start or an ability node grants (ability-catalog-v1.json), null on every other node. stat: the StatType numbers of item-schema-v1.json; kind: 1 added (summed with the gear's lines), 2 more (a multiplier of its own); valueMax: the high end of an "adds X to Y" line, null on every other. edges: undirected, each once with the smaller id first. class: 1 warrior, 2 wizard, 3 hunter, 4 cleric.
